ङ: 1. ङ the 5th consonant of the Sanskṛt alphabet, nasal of the 1st class. No word in use begins with this letter
it is usually found as the 1st member of a conjunct consonant preceded by a vowel.
2. ङ m. an object of sense, L.
desire for any sensual object, L.
ङकार: ङ—कार m. the letter or sound ङ.
ङु: ङु cl. 1. Ā. ङवते, to sound, Dhātup. xxii, 57 : Desid. ञुङूषते, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 62 Sch.
